=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py: _load_document, lines 190-203 (twin); .claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py:180-194 will inherit after twin sync | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The round-2 tightening rejects unparseable `{` lines and result-shaped objects `_page` refuses, but a stray wrapper line that is itself a valid empty page (e.g. `{"data": []}` or `{"ccr": {"data": []}}`) still passes `_page` validation, is appended to `found`, and — when it is the only result-shaped line — is returned as the page.
  WHY: If the harness wrapper text ever contains a single stray valid-empty-page line and the real payload is absent or not result-shaped, the janitor silently processes zero sessions for that page; finished sessions and prompt stalls on that page are deferred to the next wake. The existing test `test_wrapper_text_that_could_hide_the_real_page_exits_2` covers the truncated-real-page and malformed-real-page neighbours but not the lone-stray-empty-page case.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
